products.title: Rubber Guard: Concepts From Half Guard by Richie Martinez
products.body:
Attack With The Most Unorthodox Half Guard System In The World, As 10th Planet Black Belt Richie Martinez Shows How To Use Rubber Guard In Effective Dynamic Ways That Anyone Can Really Use

  • Fight off your back with this signature 10th Planet half guard system from Richie Martinez, and sweep and submit in unusual new ways
  • Richie Martinez is one of 10th Planet’s most recognizable and successful black belt competitors, with world-class experience competing at the highest levels of grappling
  • No flexibility required! Richie shows you how to safely apply rubber guard safely, using position and angles instead of flexibility or joint stress.
  • Learn positions like the Jersey, meathook, chill dog, and more, as Richie explains the techniques and the wild 10th Planet names
  • See how to enter into Jersey, how to attack for sweeps and submissions, and some of Richie’s favorite flows from half guard


Attack With The Most Unorthodox Half Guard System In The World, As 10th Planet Black Belt Richie Martinez Shows How To Use Rubber Guard In Effective Dynamic Ways That Anyone Can Really Use

 

 

What Will You Learn?

Half guard is one of the most common and effective positions in all of grappling, and now you can learn this dynamic and unique half guard system from 10th Planet black belt Richie Martinez. Use these rubber guard concepts to enter into Richie’s half guard Jersey position, and start sweeping and submitting in unique ways!

﻿Use Your Half Guard In New, Dynamic Ways!

 

Everyone looks at the rubber guard style of 10th Planet and thinks they need crazy natural flexibility to make it work, but Richie will show you how it’s actually all about positioning and angles. With these tips and techniques, you will see how Richie has taught this same style to so many students of different ages and body types.

﻿Attack Systematically With Sweeps & Subs!

 

 

Use some of rubber guard’s most effective attacks from this super strong half guard, as Richie shows you all the sweeps and submissions he uses regularly. Use gogoplatas, the carni shoulder lock, and the short stop with precise technique and full leverage. This offensive system, over 3 parts, can give your half guard a complete new look, one that is as creative as it is effective!

﻿Hook In With Rubber Guard Secrets!

 

 

So, What Exactly Do You Get?

Part 1:

  • Introduction
  • Entries to Jersey
  • Butterfly Entry to Jersey
  • From Z-guard to Jersey
  • Turtle to Jersey
  • Jail Break to Jersey
  • Meathook Attacks From Jersey
  • Meathook to Triangle
  • Meathook to The Stock
  • Rubber Guard Fundamentals
  • Stock Sweep to Mounted Gogo

Part 2:

  • Jersey to Chill Dog
  • Carni
  • Gogoplata
  • Gogo Clinch
  • Jersey Sweep
  • Shortstop
  • Short Stop/Carni
  • Short Stop/Omoplata
  • Short Stop Sweep
  • Lockdown/Super Stop/Jersey/Omoplata
  • Short Stop/Armbar

Part 3:

  • Flo
  • Failed Jersey/Back Take
  • Stock Submission Flow
  • Outro

So, What Does It All Cost?

$77

products.title: Guard Master: How To guard Them All by Geo Martinez
products.body:
Attack Relentlessly From Your Back With 10th-Planet Black Belt & Elite Competitor Geo Martinez’s Creative & Effective System For No-Gi Guard Play
  • Use the no-gi guard to take the back, sweep on top, and get to submission locks, all supercharged with Geo’s 10th Planet creativity
  • Fight with a De La X guard, Geo’s Butter Half, reverse De La Riva, and more for multiple opportunities to attack
  • Get an inside look at the 10th-Planet guard that Geo has learned and innovated on to create this unique system
  • You don’t need crazy flexibility or speed to do any of these moves, Geo shows you how he teaches his students to use these techniques at any level
  • Geo Martinez is one of the most prominent and successful 10th Planet Jiu-Jitsu black belts, with his own school and incredible success against elite compeition

Learn Classic 10th Planet Positions And Attacks Like The Lock Down, De La X, Homie Control, And More!

 

Check out a free sample:

What Will You Learn?

The no-gi guard continues to evolve and Geo Martinez has been on the forefront of that movement with his creative and effective work from his back. Now is your chance to learn from this elite competitor and 10th Planet Jiu-Jitsu black belt instructor as Geo shows you all the techniques and strategies you can use for guard success on this 4-volume series.

Fight from your back with details on some of Geo’s best guards, including De La X, reverse De La Riva, spiral guard, and more. Combine these highly effective positions with Geo’s advice on getting the most leverage possible, including some of his favorite combinations for competition.

Geo shows you the butter half guard that he has developed over the year for incredible offensive output. With only a few modifications to classic half, you can begin attacking with kimuras, guillotines, lockdowns, and more. This half guard system is a great position for grapplers of all ages to slow down the fight and attack on their own terms.

Geo Martinez is one of 10th Planet’s premier black belts, with an incredible competition career that includes multiple ADCC appearances and EBI Championships. His system that he teaches is safe, effective, and useful for grapplers of all ages - no crazy athleticism or flexibility necessary.


So, What Exactly Do You Get?

products.title: Blender Passing by Andy Varela
products.body:
Use The Blender System to Pass the Guard More Effectively and Keep Yourself Free From The Pitfalls of Modern BJJ Featuring 2022 ADCC West Coast Trials Runner-Up Andy Varela
  • Discover multiple ways to stay safe but still intelligently approach and attack the bottom player with Varela’s one of a kind blueprints you won’t see anywhere else
  • 10th Planet Black Belt and ADCC West Coast Trials Runner-Up Andy Varela reveals his system for long range and headquarters style passing to help you pass with more efficiency and avoid common dangers from bottom players
  • Utilize Varela’s unique approach to stay out of leg locks and other dangerous conundrums as you attempt to pass
  • Pass the guard while maintaining good balance, a good competitive mindset, and strong passing ability, in this perfectly constructed instructional for developing a more reliable top game 
  • Blend multiple passes seamlessly to outflank your opponents and develop a game plan for passing that's unstoppable
  • Master knee cut variations, force the half butterfly guard and dismantle it, sharpen your backstep, tight up your toreando, and so much more in this ultimate guide to intelligent guard passing with a respected 10th Planet Black belt at the helm

products.title: Mount Dominance by Brandon McCaghren
products.body:
Develop a More Dominant Mount and Learn The “Musts” of The No Gi Top Game Featuring 10th Planet Black Belt Instructor, Brandon McCaghren
  • Brandon McCaghren is a black belt under Eddie Bravo and one of 10th Planet’s most acclaimed instructors, staking his claim as the first 10P instructor in the Southeastern United States
  • Take an unorthodox approach to some classic jiu-jitsu themes, and revolutionize the way you attack from one of BJJ’s most underutilized positions, all with a 10th Planet Black Belt at the helm
  • The mount is an entirely different animal in no gi and we must adapt our games to reflect these major differences so we can still dominate from this important position
  • Learn superior body positioning tactics that you’ve never seen before so you can transform your no gi mount game from average to extraordinary
  • Explore a densely packed instructional that includes positional guidance, tons of submissions, finishing mechanics, mount maintenance strategies, and more all with the added 10th Planet flare that you’ll only get from a seasoned 10P black belt
  • Discover the spiderweb, the mounted rubber guard sugar hold, the punch choke, mounted triangle gold, multiple back takes, the chopping block, and more, all with exquisite details and guidance you won’t find anywhere else
